high_level_description: This is a black-and-white portrait of a person with long hair. The individual appears to be looking directly at the camera, giving a sense of engagement with the viewer. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the contours of the face and the texture of the hair. The background is plain and out of focus, ensuring that the attention remains on the subject. The person's hair is styled in loose waves, cascading over the shoulders. The makeup is subtle yet defined, with noticeable eyeliner and mascara enhancing the eyes.
